name: EXBOX.MD Dante / MADI converter
notes: Dante / MADI converter: 64 channels both ways between Dante (or AES67) and MADI. Network: 4 x RJ45 1 Gb/s on an internal switch, 01 (PoE) and 02 primary, 03 and 04 secondary (Dante redundancy). One-third 19 inch width: 140 x 42 x 140 mm (W x H x D), about 1 kg. Three fit side by side in 1RU on the BOXMOUNT.XL kit. Power: 2 x Hirose 4-pin DC inlets (9-24V, PSU 1 and 2; one external supply included, a second is optional) or PoE (802.3af) on network port 01. MADI: coaxial BNC out and in, optical SC duplex (multi-mode; single-mode version available) and an SFP cage (transceiver sold separately). Front: LEDs for clock source, sample rate, state and power only. FastSRC sample rate converters on the network side. 44.1-192 kHz, MADI 56/64 ch, 48k/96k frame, S/MUX.

One-third 19 inch width: 140 x 42 x 140 mm (W x H x D), about 1 kg. Three fit side by side in 1RU on the BOXMOUNT.XL kit. Power: 2 x Hirose 4-pin DC inlets (9-24V, PSU 1 and 2; one external supply included, a second is optional) or PoE (802.3af) on network port 01. MADI: coaxial BNC out and in, optical SC duplex (multi-mode; single-mode version available) and an SFP cage (transceiver sold separately). Front: LEDs for clock source, sample rate, state and power only. FastSRC sample rate converters on the network side. 44.1-192 kHz, MADI 56/64 ch, 48k/96k frame, S/MUX.

name: EXBOX.SG SoundGrid / MADI converter
notes: SoundGrid / MADI converter: links a Waves SoundGrid network with MADI. Network: 4 x RJ45 1 Gb/s on an internal switch (one with PoE). Word clock in on BNC. One-third 19 inch width: 140 x 42 x 140 mm (W x H x D), about 1 kg. Three fit side by side in 1RU on the BOXMOUNT.XL kit. Power: 2 x Hirose 4-pin DC inlets (9-24V, PSU 1 and 2; one external supply included, a second is optional) or PoE (802.3af) on network port 01. MADI: coaxial BNC out and in, optical SC duplex (multi-mode; single-mode version available) and an SFP cage (transceiver sold separately). name: BOXMOUNT.XL 1RU rack kit for 3 EXBOX
notes: 1RU 19 inch mounting kit that holds up to three one-third width EXBOX units (EXBOX.MD, EXBOX.RAV, EXBOX.SG) side by side. Add each EXBOX as its own device. Check: part number and whether it also takes other one-third width units.

name: MONTONE.42 MADI / RAVENNA (AES67, ST 2110-30) bridge
notes: 1RU bridge between 4 MADI ports and RAVENNA / AES67 / SMPTE ST 2110-30/-31 (with ST 2022-7 redundancy on the 2 network ports). Each MADI port is ordered as SC (single- or multi-mode), coaxial BNC or SFP cage. Word clock in (AES11/DARS) and out, black burst video reference in. Front: 3 small displays, controls, headphone jack and a USB service port. 2 phase-redundant supplies on separate IEC inlets with power switches, 15 W. 483 x 44.5 x 254 mm, about 4 kg. Check: USB service connector type.

name: ANDIAMO 32-channel AD/DA converter (MADI, network)
notes: Third generation ANDIAMO: 32 analog inputs and 32 outputs on 8 balanced DB25 (AES59) connectors, 2 MADI ports on SFP cages (transceivers sold separately), an optional audio network card (RAVENNA/AES67, Dante or SoundGrid) with 2 RJ45 ports on independent NICs, RJ45 management, word clock BNCs. 2 phase-redundant supplies on separate IEC inlets with power switches. 483 x 44.5 x 254 mm, about 4 kg. Check: whether the 8 DB25 split 4 in / 4 out, and which word clock BNC is in or out.

name: PRODIGY.MC modular audio converter
notes: Modular converter: 1 A slot (up to 128 ch), 2 B slots (64 ch each), 8 C slots (8 ch each). 2RU, 483 x 89 x 254 mm, about 10 kg. 2 phase-redundant supplies (84-264V AC), 20-110 W depending on modules. Front: 5 inch touch display, encoder, 2 buttons, headphone outputs on 6.3 mm and 3.5 mm jacks. Its I/O comes from plug-in modules: A slots take an audio network module (Dante, RAVENNA/AES67, SoundGrid, MILAN, dual-network), 2-port MADI (MADI2.SRC.IO on SFP, MADI2.BNC.SRC.IO) or USB.IO; B slots take 1-port MADI (BNC.IO, SC.IO, SFP.IO); C slots take 8-channel converters on DB25 (AN8.IO, MIC8.HD.IO, MIC8.LINE.IO, AES4.IO). Slots are shown as card-slot ports; add the module connectors to the device to match the build. Check: power inlet type (IEC assumed).

name: PRODIGY.MP multifunction audio processor
notes: Audio processor (DSP, matrix, tools): 2 A slots, 2 B slots, 4 C slots, up to 416 inputs and 420 outputs. 2RU, 483 x 89 x 254 mm, about 10 kg. 2 phase-redundant supplies (84-264V AC), 20-110 W depending on modules. Front: 5 inch touch display, encoder, 2 buttons, headphone outputs on 6.3 mm and 3.5 mm jacks. Slots are shown as card-slot ports; add the module connectors to the device to match the build. Check: power inlet type (IEC assumed).
